application_notification_subscription_re.name: application_notification_subscription_recipient_check
application_notification_subscription_re.value:
("application_notification_subscription"."recipient_kind" = 'hiring_inbox' AND "application_notification_subscription"."user_id" IS NULL AND "application_notification_subscription"."member_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("application_notification_subscription"."recipient_kind" = 'member' AND "application_notification_subscription"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "application_notification_subscription"."member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "application_notification_subscription"."recipient_email" IS NULL)
